title: File:Rang Ghar The first Indian pavilion.jpg
author: Nayan j Nath
description: Rang Ghar, located at Rupahi Pathar in Sivasagar, Assam, is known as the first sports pavilion in India. It was originally built in the mid-18th century during the reign of Swargadeo Rudra Singha as a royal sports pavilion for the Ahom kings. Later, between 1744 and 1751 A.D., Swargadeo Pramatta Singha rebuilt the two-storeyed architectural structure.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
